pages.text: Bring a ranged option and watch your footing. The Aether is a $(t4)Tier 4$() dimension of aerial combat on floating islands. Deep Aether has no dimension of its own: its biomes grow on the same islands.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Three dungeon bosses each drop a Simply Swords unique and a Too Many Bows bow: the Slider (Bronze), the Valkyrie Queen (Silver) and the Sun Spirit (Gold). The Eye of the Storm (Brass Dungeon) is the Aether's apex.

$(bold)Hazards:$() Thin air above y 180 gives you Weakness unless your armour carries Aether Acclimation, and sprinting above y 200 brings vertigo. An updraft slows a fall into the void, but only once. Aether mobs are fast; swets, whirlwinds, cockatrices and zephyrs grow with the Tier 4 curve.

$(bold)Materials:$() Zanite, Gravitite and Ambrosium are native to the Aether. Deep Aether adds Skyjade and Stratus, and $(bold)Aethersteel$() ore hides in its holystone. Dying here costs 22% durability.

$(bold)No guide book.$() You learn the Aether by exploring it. Each dungeon has lore to discover, and the $(bold)Book of Lore$() found in them gives in-world context.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Slider in the Bronze Dungeon$(), the Aether's first boss and your shot at Thunderbrand.
